main.description: Ingest a single user input (text / url / file_ref) and start a LangGraph run. The run classifies the intake into a project (existing or new), routes through a kind-specific processor, and writes an artifact. Returns immediately with run_id; poll downstream queries for status. Per ADR-2605080800.

sourceKind.description: Input modality. text = inline string, url = http(s) link to fetch, file_ref = b2://… reference.

rawText.description: Required when sourceKind=text. Raw user-supplied content.

sourceUri.description: Required when sourceKind ∈ {url, file_ref}. http(s):// for url, b2:// for file_ref.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag hint (e.g., ja, en). Optional — parser auto-detects when omitted.

projectHint.description: Optional slug of an existing project the user wants this intake bound to. When set, classify_project is skipped and the intake is forced into the named project.

runId.description: LangGraph thread_id == run_id == sha256(actor_did + ts_ms + intake_hash).

status.description: Initial status. Almost always pending/running on this call.

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Required field missing or sourceKind mismatch.
